name: Bakuretsu Otome Sexy Mary
source:
In Shinko Cosmo-Frontier Academy city a young woman suddenly disappears. Then dormitory gets attacked by "Hectocylus" devils. Main character takes the decision to transplant the seed of evil to gain superpowers one of the victim girls. As a result the girl becomes Sexy Mary and fights evil forces with the ways she can.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在新光Cosmo-Frontier学园都市，一名年轻女性突然失踪。紧接着，宿舍遭到“Hectocylus”恶魔袭击。主人公决定把邪恶之种移植给一名受害少女，让她获得超能力。少女因此变身为Sexy Mary，以自己力所能及的方式与邪恶势力战斗。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
